package records

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/bindly/resource"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	bootstrapindex "github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap/index"
	dexec "github.com/viant/datly/exec"
	gateway "github.com/viant/datly/gateway/http"
	"github.com/viant/datly/internal/testharness/sqlite"
	"github.com/viant/datly/mcp"
	druntime "github.com/viant/datly/runtime"
	rhandler "github.com/viant/datly/runtime/handler"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	dsql "github.com/viant/datly/sql"
)

type privateLoader struct{ registration *druntime.RegisteredComponent }

func (l privateLoader) LoadComponent(_ context.Context, key spec.Key) (*druntime.RegisteredComponent, error) {
	if key != l.registration.Component.Key {
		return nil, errors.New("unexpected component")
	}
	return l.registration, nil
}

func TestGeneratedPrivateReader(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	const pkg = "github.com/viant/datly/privatereaderfixture/records"
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	resources := resource.New()
	holder := reflect.New(PrivateReadDatlyType()).Interface()
	linkedResources := bootstrap.LinkedResources([]any{holder}, pkg)
	require.NotEmpty(t, linkedResources)
	for namespace, fs := range linkedResources {
		require.NoError(t, resources.Register(namespace, fs))
	}
	linked, err := bootstrap.ReflectPackages([]string{pkg})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, linked.Components, 1)
	component, err := linked.Components[0].Resolve(reflect.TypeFor[PrivateInput](), reflect.TypeFor[PrivateOutput]())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, component.Routes[0].Internal)
	snapshot, err := (bootstrapindex.Builder{Config: bootstrapindex.Config{BaseDir: filepath.Dir(cwd), Include: []string{pkg}}}).Build(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	entries := snapshot.Entries()
	require.Len(t, entries, 1)
	require.True(t, entries[0].Component.Routes[0].Internal)
	for _, mode := range []string{"eager", "indexed"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			db := sqlite.New(t)
			require.NoError(t, db.ExecStatements(ctx, "CREATE TABLE records(id INTEGER, name TEXT)", "INSERT INTO records VALUES(1,'private')"))
			c := component.Clone()
			c.Settings.Cache.Location = t.TempDir()
			artifact, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{Component: c,
				InputType: reflect.TypeFor[PrivateInput](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[PrivateOutput](), Resources: resources})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			reader, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: db.DB}})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			registration, err := artifact.Registration(druntime.RegisteredComponent{Reader: reader})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			target := spec.RouteRef{Method: "GET", Path: "/api/private/read"}
			parent, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{
				Component: &spec.Component{Key: spec.Key{Kind: spec.KindComponent, Name: "Public"},
					Routes:   []*spec.Route{{Method: "GET", Path: "/api/public", APIKeyHeader: "X-Reader-Key", APIKeyValue: "secret"}},
					Settings: &spec.Settings{WarmupTarget: &target}},
				InputType: reflect.TypeFor[struct{}](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[struct{}](),
			})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			parentCalls := 0
			parentRegistration := &druntime.RegisteredComponent{Component: parent.Component, Input: parent.Input,
				OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[PrivateOutput](),
				Handler: rhandler.HandlerFunc(func(ctx context.Context, inv rhandler.Invocation) (any, error) {
					parentCalls++
					value, found, err := inv.Binder.Lookup(ctx, dexec.ComponentInvokerKey)
					require.NoError(t, err)
					require.True(t, found)
					return value.(dexec.ComponentInvoker).InvokeComponent(ctx, dexec.ComponentRequest{
						Target: dexec.ComponentTarget{Component: artifact.Component.Key, Route: target}, Input: &PrivateInput{},
					})
				}),
			}
			var rt *druntime.Runtime
			config := mcp.Config{}
			if mode == "indexed" {
				indexed := []*spec.Component{entries[0].Component, parent.Component}
				// Warmable components are preloaded before HTTP warmup publication.
				rt, err = druntime.NewIndexedRuntime(indexed, []*druntime.RegisteredComponent{registration, parentRegistration}, privateLoader{registration})
				config.Indexed, config.Loader = indexed, rt
			} else {
				config.Components = []*druntime.RegisteredComponent{registration, parentRegistration}
				rt, err = druntime.NewRuntime(config.Components)
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, rt.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
			require.False(t, rt.ExposesComponent(component.Key))
			require.False(t, rt.ExposesMCPComponent(component.Key))
			config.Invoker = rt
			service, err := mcp.New(config)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, service.PrepareTools(ctx))
			_, exposed := service.Registry().ToolRegistry.Get("PrivateRead")
			require.False(t, exposed)
			warmupConfig := gateway.Config{APIPrefix: "/api", Meta: gateway.Meta{CacheWarmURI: "/admin/warm"},
				Warmup: &gateway.WarmupConfig{Lifetime: gateway.NewWarmupLifetime(ctx), Timeout: time.Minute,
					AdminHeaders: []string{"X-Admin"}, Completed: func(_ gateway.WarmupResult, err error) {},
					Authorize: func(_ context.Context, request *http.Request, target dexec.ComponentTarget) error {
						if request.Header.Get("X-Admin") != "yes" || target.Route.Path != "/api/private/read" {
							return errors.New("denied")
						}
						return nil
					}},
			}
			handler, err := warmupConfig.NewHandler(rt, nil, "test")
			require.NoError(t, err)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, handler.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
			for _, tc := range []struct {
				method, path, credential, admin string
				status                          int
			}{
				{"GET", "/api/private/read", "", "", 404},
				{"GET", "/api/private/read", "secret", "", 404},
				{"POST", "/admin/warm/public", "", "yes", 403},
				{"POST", "/admin/warm/public", "secret", "", 403},
				{"POST", "/admin/warm/public", "secret", "yes", 200},
			} {
				request := httptest.NewRequest(tc.method, tc.path, nil)
				request.Header.Set("X-Reader-Key", tc.credential)
				request.Header.Set("X-Admin", tc.admin)
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
				require.Equal(t, tc.status, response.Code, response.Body.String())
				if tc.method == "POST" {
					var result gateway.WarmupResult
					require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &result))
					if tc.status == 200 {
						require.Equal(t, "ok", result.Status)
						require.Positive(t, result.Groups)
					} else {
						require.Zero(t, result.Groups)
					}
				}
			}
			require.Zero(t, parentCalls, "warmup must not execute enrichment")
			request := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/api/public", nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-Reader-Key", "secret")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
			require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), `"Name":"private"`)
			require.Equal(t, 1, parentCalls)
		})
	}
}
